name: Formbricks Cloud Hobby
free_limit: 250 survey responses/month; 1 workspace; link and in-product surveys; full API access including MCP
watch_out: This is the provider-hosted Formbricks Cloud Hobby tier, not the separately self-hosted Community Edition. Hobby includes 250 responses/month, one workspace and Formbricks branding; the full API (including MCP) is included. The paid Pro tier advertises optional dynamic response-overage handling, which must NOT be assumed available or automatically billable on Hobby. Credit-card and commercial-use terms beyond published plan details should not be inferred.
